Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (‘Listing

Services Tax Act, 2017 initiated by the Maharashtra State GST officials at the Registered Office of the Company at
Mumbai.
The Company extended its co-operation with the officials and provided necessary information and documents. The
information as required under Clause 19 of Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations read
with relevant SEBI Circulars is enclosed in the Annexure I.

The inspection and search proceedings commenced on October 9, 2026,
and concluded on October 14, 2026.All compliances were voluntarily
complete and all reversals, payments have been done.

4

Details of the violation(s)/
contravention(s) committed
or alleged to be committed;

During the course of the investigation, the following matters relating to
Input Tax Credit (ITC) were identified:
 Inadmissible Input Tax Credit (ITC): Inadmissible Input Tax Credit
(ITC) availed on Offer for Sale (OFS)-related expenses under Section
17(2) of the MGST Act, 2017 has been reversed.
 Ineligible ITC on Rights Issue Expenses: ITC attributable to another
State (Rajasthan), alleged to be ineligible under Section 20 of the MGST
Act, 2017.
 ITC Pertaining to Cancelled Supplier: Liability arising in respect of ITC
relating to cancelled supplier.
 ITC Distribution through ISD: Proper distribution of Input Tax Credit
(ITC) through the Input Service Distributor (ISD) mechanism under
Section 20 of the MGST Act, 2017, has been undertaken, and the ITC
previously availed has been reversed.
 Blocked ITC: ITC availed in GSTR-3B, alleged to be inadmissible under
Section 17(5) of the MGST Act, 2017.

 5

Impact on financial, operation
or other activities of the listed
entity,
quantifiable
in
monetary terms to the extent
possible

The Company has taken appropriate steps to address the observations
raised by the GST authorities and has paid the tax and interest liability
communicated in connection with the proceedings. The Company does
not anticipate any material impact on its ongoing operations or other
business activities. The matters primarily relate to Input Tax Credit (ITC)
adjustments and rectifications, major part of which is revenue-neutral,
subject to the applicable tax treatment. The Company continues to take
appropriate steps to ensure compliance with the applicable provisions of
the GST law.

Subject: Outcome of the Board Meeting held on October 15, 2026
Dear Madany/ Sir,

Pursuant to Regulation 30 and other applicable regulations of the Securities and Exchange Board of
India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing
Regulations”), we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of Fujiyama Power Systems
Limited (“the Company”) at its meeting held on Thursday, October 15, 2026 has, inter alia,
considered and approved:
Raising of funds by way of issuance of equity shares of the Company through a Qualified
Institutions Placement (“QIP”), in accordance with the applicable provisions of the
Companies Act, 2013, the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Issue of Capital and
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, as amended, and other applicable acts, rules
and regulations, subject to the approval of the shareholders, the stock exchanges and receipt
of such regulatory, statutory and other approvals as may be applicable, with a view to
achieving and maintaining the minimum public shareholding requirements of the
Company.
In order to give effect to the above, the Board has constituted and authorised the “QIP
Committee” of the Board, comprising the Directors, to, inter alia, determine the size, timing,

number and price of the issue, identify eligible Qualified Institutional Buyers (‘QIBs’),
approve allocation and allotment, appoint necessary intermediaries and advisors, finalise the
placement and other transaction documents, make requisite filings and applications with the
concemed authorities, obtain listing and trading approvals, and undertake all other acts,
deeds and matters necessary or incidental to the proposed fund raising.
The Company will seek approval from the shareholders in relation to the matter mentioned
above through postal ballot, subject to applicable provisions/ circulars issued by the Ministry
of Corporate Affairs from time to time. The postal ballot notice will be circulated to the
shareholders in due course, in accordance with applicable laws.

 3. Incorporation of Wholly Owned Subsidiary for Renewable Energy Business
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements)

its meeting held today, has approved the incorporation of a Wholly Owned Subsidiary ("WOS")/Special Purpose
